Native retired-link/stamp storage remains MAP05/06. Engine payoff28 retains the d0 observed-obstruction latch through request completion. A blocked cell anywhere on an expanded perimeter matters, not only the reconstructed route. The union of every class neighbor mask covers the full perimeter; missing edges latch the C search flag.480 full original/C requests match.
